items.originalTitle: ALMA resolves the gravitational reach of a black hole in the early universe
items.title: ALMA resolves the gravitational reach of a black hole in the early universe
items.summary: Astronomers using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) measured the mass of a supermassive black hole in WISE J224607.56−052634.9, also known as W2246-0526. Its light has been stretched by the expansion of the universe to about 5.6 times its original wavelength. This shift, called redshift, tells astronomers that we see the galaxy as it was when the universe was about 1.3 billion years old.

It’s a weird situation that, right now, the feature-packed AirPods Pro 3 are the same price as the newer (but less impressive) AirPods 5 that include the wireless charging case. The Pro 3 deliver considerably more bang for your buck. AirPods Pro 3 Where to Buy: $249 $149 at Amazon $249 $149 at Walmart $249 $149.99 at Best Buy This model is Apple’s best-sounding, longest-lasting AirPods, and they ship with five silicone ear tips. Compared to the second-gen AirPod Pro, these offer better water resistance (IP57 versus IP54), longer battery life per charge (eight hours versus six), improved noise cancellation, and heart rate sensing through built-in sensors.
